title: fix(objectql): insert and delete open their after-abort unit inside the middleware chain, as update does
body:
Fixes #35167

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 用户能看到什么变化：给对象绑了会写数据的前置钩子或会拦截的后置钩子之后，新增和删除在单连接数据库（SQLite）上不再让别人的写入排在权限检查后面等待，三个动词（新增、修改、删除）的事务边界从此是同一条规则。
2. 为什么做：上一轮「抢领记录输家答错」的修复只改了修改，你选了「三个动词一条规则」，这一单把新增和删除补齐。
3. 出错会怎样：受影响的只有绑了这类钩子的对象；最坏情况是某个插件在写入之后做的收尾工作不再和这一行同进同退（与没绑钩子的对象一致），回滚这一个 PR 即可恢复。
4. 要你做什么：无，席位落地。

## 席位核对

### What changes

- `insert` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-insert.ts`) and `delete` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`) no longer re-enter their own door inside `inAfterAbortUnit`. Each computes `opensAfterAbortUnit` once at the door and wraps only the executor it hands `executeWithMiddleware` (`inOwnUnit`), the shape `engine-update.ts` has used since #35165. The middleware chain (the authorization gate's reads, and any post-`next()` work) runs outside the unit; the `before*` hooks' `ctx.api` writes, the row and the `after*` chain run inside it. Nothing between the door and the executor writes (insert: normalisation and `opCtx`; delete: option folding, `withResolvedWhere`, and the in-memory cascade claim).
- The now-unread `'insert'` / `'delete'` members leave the two facets' `this` Picks.
- The three prose places now state one rule: `engine-hook-dispatch.ts` (`inAfterAbortUnit` docblock), `engine-top-level.ts` (the four paths that open a unit around the `after*` dispatch), `engine-middleware-and-context.ts` (`claimReferentialCascadeDelete`: no `delete()` re-enters itself).
- `scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs`: the resolution control pinned on the delete door's `this.delete(...)` re-entry matched no call site once that re-entry was gone (`check:swallow-census-controls` red, "A control that matches nothing passes VACUOUSLY"). It is re-pointed at the same facet-stub shape on `insertMany`'s `this.insert(...)` in `InsertFacet`. This file is outside the claim's file surface; see Acceptance notes.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/objectql` patch.

Not changed: the delete loser's `false` vs `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` answer and what fires on a driver `false` (the follow-up card that lands after this PR); `after*` stays inside the write's unit (#7477).

### Tests

Two new files in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/` (shape of `ownership-claim-race-sqlite.test.ts`: `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver` on better-sqlite3 `:memory:` + `SecurityPlugin`; that package's vitest config aliases `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/driver-sql` to source):

- `insert-unit-inside-middleware-sqlite.test.ts`, `delete-unit-inside-middleware-sqlite.test.ts`. Cells per verb: no metadata hook, a metadata `before*` hook, only a blocking `after*` hook. A test middleware parks user A's write after the security gate and before `next()`; user B's write on another row must settle within 2 s while A is parked. Control per verb: a throwing `after*` hook (asserted by identity) leaves no inserted row / leaves the deleted row stored.

<details><summary>Ablation, per verb (fix committed first; mutation = the file restored from base 24cc61fab, then `git checkout HEAD --` and hash match)</summary>

- insert, `engine-insert.ts` at base (door re-entry count 1, `inOwnUnit` 0): `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`; both hooked cells `Expected: "fulfilled" Received: "still waiting"`; no-hook cell and control green. Restored: hash match, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- delete, `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts` at base: `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`, same two cells red with the same reading; restored, hash match.
- Control re-point in the census script, mutated with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (`resolvesIn: 'InsertFacet'` to `'UpdateFacet'`, anchor x1 to x0): self-test red, `resolution control moved: … expected UpdateFacet, got InsertFacet@307, InsertFacet@1760`; restored, hash match.

</details>

<details><summary>Suites (final head 155c9e54ec, after merging origin/main)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` then `test`: `Test Files 614 passed (614)`, `Tests 13878 passed (13878)`.
- the two new files plus `ownership-claim-race-sqlite.test.ts`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 15 passed (15)`.
- Before the merge (d5bfdb05c line): `@objectstack/plugin-security` typecheck exit 0 and `test`: `Test Files 281 passed (281)`, `Tests 6993 passed | 45 skipped`.

</details>

### Acceptance notes

- File-surface breach, one file: `scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs`. Necessary because the change made its control vacuous; the re-point keeps the same resolution shape live rather than deleting the control.
- Wording only, left as is: `engine-transactions-section.ts:161`, `hook-wrappers.ts:533` and `unit-detach.ts:21` call it "the door's own unit". They name the write's own unit and say nothing about where it opens, so they stay true.
- A middleware that throws after `next()` on a hooked object no longer rolls the insert or delete back. That already held for `update` and for every unhooked object; the changeset says so.
